columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier for each stock record

columns.name: sku
columns.description: Stock keeping unit, part of composite unique key with location

columns.name: location
columns.description: Storage location, part of composite unique key with sku

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Current stock quantity, must be non-negative per PI3

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Code identifying the inventory batch or source

columns.name: timestamp
columns.description: When the record was created or last updated, immutable per NFR-F1-1

columns.name: actor
columns.description: Who created or modified the record (user ID or service name), immutable per NFR-F1-1

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records table with (sku, location) composite unique constraint, NOT NULL constraints on addressing and value columns, and CHECK constraint for non-negative quantity. Includes timestamp and actor for immutable audit trail.
schema_changes.migration_note: Initial additive migration; reversible downgrade drops the table; existing records pre-migration are preserved per evolutionary database design principle
